observation: Wwox-KO layer II/III slice burst is abolished by d-APV; immature cortex is GluN2B-dominant
relation_hypothesised: The burst is carried by GluN2B-containing NMDARs
context: Wwox-KO mouse neocortical slice, young/immature layer II/III; age not stated
benefit_to_verify: Burst suppression by a GluN2B NAM; localization of the burst to GluN2B
measured_or_inferred_per_step: obs=measured (slice); relation=inferred from developmental expression; action=speculative
favourable_reason: Developmental GluN2B dominance; radiprodil voltage/use-independent like d-APV; human-safe per cited source
unfavourable_or_alternative: Burst may be GluN2A-, GluN2C/D- or mixed-driven; WWOX loss may change subunit composition
discriminating_experiment: Radiprodil/ifenprodil vs GluN2A-preferring antagonist (TCN-201, MPX-004, NVP-AAM077-type) in the Wwox-KO slice
reasoning_pattern: A subunit that dominates the developmental stage in healthy tissue is assumed to carry a pathological network event, and a subunit-selective drug is chosen as both treatment and probe

observation: d-APV abolishes the burst regardless of channel state
relation_hypothesised: The burst is driven by phasic/regenerative NMDAR current, reachable by open-channel blockers; if tonic, blockers fail at physiological Mg2+
possible_action: Memantine or ketamine suppress the burst
context: Wwox-KO slice at physiological Mg2+ and resting potential; immature neurons
benefit_to_verify: Burst sensitivity to memantine/ketamine versus d-APV across Mg2+ and holding potential
measured_or_inferred_per_step: obs=measured (d-APV); relation=inferred from drug mechanism; action=speculative
favourable_reason: Pore blockers act on receptors opened by depolarization; if the burst is regenerative they should suppress it, possibly more selectively than d-APV
unfavourable_or_alternative: Tonic/extrasynaptic drive may be inaccessible to use-/voltage-dependent blockers; burst may persist under memantine
discriminating_experiment: Vary extracellular Mg2+ and holding potential; compare d-APV with memantine/ketamine at clinically achievable brain concentrations
reasoning_pattern: A drug's state-dependent binding mechanism determines whether it can reproduce a state-independent tool-compound effect, so the state of the target during the phenotype becomes the discriminator

observation: ATP1A2-related DEE infant responded to ketamine then became seizure-free with memantine added
relation_hypothesised: Memantine can control seizures driven by NMDAR-related excitability in a monogenic DEE
possible_action: Test memantine as tolerability-weighted channel blocker in the Wwox-KO slice
context: Single infant with ATP1A2-related DEE; other disorder
benefit_to_verify: Whether memantine reproduces the d-APV effect in the WWOX preparation
measured_or_inferred_per_step: obs=measured (single case, other gene); relation=inferred; action=speculative
favourable_reason: Oral, approved, low-affinity pathologically-activated block, direct monogenic-DEE precedent
unfavourable_or_alternative: Single case with ketamine co-treatment; no WWOX data; subunit preference weak (GluN2C/D); developmental safety "~"
discriminating_experiment: Memantine arm of the Mg2+/voltage experiment (C02)
reasoning_pattern: A response in a neighbouring monogenic DEE is carried to the genotype through a shared pharmacological node (NMDAR block)

observation: Ketamine terminates refractory SE in about half of cases and works in neonates, with sequelae
relation_hypothesised: Ketamine as positive control would suppress the burst if any open-channel block works
possible_action: Use ketamine as acute positive control or rescue, not chronic therapy
context: Slice positive control; clinical SE precedent in adults, children, neonates
benefit_to_verify: Establishes whether open-channel block can suppress the burst at all
measured_or_inferred_per_step: obs=measured (clinical series, other conditions); relation=inferred; action=speculative
favourable_reason: CNS-penetrant, potent, enhanced block in immature neurons
unfavourable_or_alternative: Neurodevelopmental apoptosis; sequelae in 4/5 neonatal survivors; poor outcome in NKH
discriminating_experiment: Ketamine arm with parallel caspase-3 assay
reasoning_pattern: Efficacy in a generic hyperexcitability state (status epilepticus) is used as a surrogate for suppression of a genotype-specific network event

observation: NMDAR blockade during synaptogenesis causes apoptosis; WOREE onset overlaps this window
relation_hypothesised: Burst-suppressing concentration may not sit below the apoptotic concentration, making transfer harmful
possible_action: Therapeutic-index assay in developing cortex before any translation
context: Developing cortex preparations; human infantile window; ketamine, MgSO4 and class data from other systems
benefit_to_verify: Whether suppression occurs well below the apoptotic threshold for each agent
measured_or_inferred_per_step: obs=measured (apoptosis in cited work, species not stated); relation=inferred for WWOX; action=speculative
favourable_reason: Provides a safety gate before translation
unfavourable_or_alternative: If suppression requires apoptotic concentrations, or WWOX tissue is more vulnerable, transfer is unjustified
discriminating_experiment: Caspase-3 positive apoptosis across the efficacious concentration range in parallel developing-cortex preparations
reasoning_pattern: A liability documented in healthy developing tissue is applied as a gate on efficacy in a diseased preparation, requiring a concentration-ratio comparison

observation: Selfotel (competitive glutamate-site antagonist) phase III aborted for excess deaths; class failures in stroke
relation_hypothesised: Competitive d-APV-like block is the least translatable mechanism
possible_action: Do not pursue competitive agents (selfotel, perzinfotel); favour allosteric/GluN2B
measured_or_inferred_per_step: obs=measured (trial outcome in other indication); relation=inferred; action=exclusion
favourable_reason: Allosteric modulators have better therapeutic indices; low-affinity blockers tolerated
unfavourable_or_alternative: Class failures in neuroprotection need not predict infantile epilepsy outcomes; perzinfotel failure uncited
reasoning_pattern: Failure of a mechanistic class in one indication is carried to exclude the same class in another indication

observation: Burst is also gap-junction dependent; monotherapy shows partial efficacy ceilings
relation_hypothesised: NMDAR and gap-junction mechanisms act in series or in parallel; partial NMDAR block leaves electrically sustained activity
possible_action: Combination of NMDA antagonist with a gap-junction modulator or a GABAergic agent
context: Wwox-KO slice; clinical SE and NKH precedent
benefit_to_verify: Whether combination abolishes residual burst activity
favourable_reason: Two dependencies of one event suggest two entry points
unfavourable_or_alternative: Gap-junction modulator unspecified; may add toxicity; d-APV alone already abolishes the burst (E04)
discriminating_experiment: NMDA antagonist alone versus plus gap-junction blocker in the slice; dose-response of residual burst
reasoning_pattern: Two necessary components of a network event are targeted together when one component alone gives partial effect

observation: Lithium/GSK-3beta inhibition abolished PTZ seizures in Wwox-null mice; no NMDAR therapy tested in WOREE
relation_hypothesised: A slice-derived NMDAR mechanism will translate to seizure outcome in a Wwox-deficient mouse
possible_action: In vivo test of the winning agent against spontaneous/evoked seizures, benchmarked against lithium
benefit_to_verify: Linking slice burst suppression to in vivo seizures
favourable_reason: Provides behavioural/EEG outcome and a benchmark
unfavourable_or_alternative: Slice network activity may not predict in vivo seizures; slice concentrations do not map to CNS exposure
discriminating_experiment: Winning slice agent tested in vivo with lithium as comparator
reasoning_pattern: A mechanism found ex vivo is validated by a downstream in vivo phenotype with an existing therapy as benchmark

observation: WWOX loss may change NMDAR subunit composition or voltage/Mg2+ sensitivity
relation_hypothesised: The d-APV slice result does not predict clinical-agent response because receptor biophysics are altered
possible_action: Characterize the NMDAR currents of Wwox-KO tissue (implied)
benefit_to_verify: Whether receptor properties differ from wild type
unfavourable_or_alternative: Unconfirmed premise; no WWOX NMDAR data
discriminating_experiment: Not specified by the report; implied comparison of subunit and Mg2+ sensitivity in KO versus control
reasoning_pattern: A knockout is assumed to modify the very target of a drug, which makes a tool-compound effect an unreliable predictor

observation: Ifenprodil and traxoprodil are GluN2B-selective allosteric modulators
relation_hypothesised: They act as tool comparators for the GluN2B hypothesis
possible_action: Use as lower-priority GluN2B probes alongside radiprodil
reasoning_pattern: A second member of a drug class is used to control for compound-specific effects

observation: Matrix lists dextromethorphan, amantadine and nitrous oxide as pore blockers with developmental concerns
relation_hypothesised: Same use-/voltage-dependent limits as memantine/ketamine, weaker evidence
possible_action: Lower priority; not proposed for testing
unfavourable_or_alternative: Neurotoxic or encephalopathy concerns, exposure limits; uncited
